text:
joyce-infra: starting cluster init for ap-south2 (mixed A100 + T4 pool). goal: kubeadm single-controlplane, two nodepools (gpu-heavy, gpu-spot), calico + metrics-server, nginx-ingress. posting preflight checklist and a couple questions.

mike-sre: nice — please call out MTU and node-to-node MTU for the VPC. last time calico defaults caused pod networking fragmentation on the T4s.

joyce-infra: noted. planned MTU 9000 for metal; will set calico FELIX_IPINIPMTU to 8972. also will disable IPIP when in same subnet.

sam-neteng: confirm underlying subnet supports jumbo frames (we validated with the provider, 9k ok). also need to whitelabel the load balancer egress.

alex-mlinfra: driver plan? we should for A100s use NVIDIA driver 535 + CUDA 12.3 and for T4s use 470 series driver compatibility mode. or use containerd with nvidia-container-toolkit.

joyce-infra: plan: use node image with preinstalled nvidia-driver 535 and install cuda only on A100 nodepool via initDaemonSet. T4 nodepool will use 535 but boot with --no-mig to avoid MIG config.

mike-sre: spot pool sizing question — what's the fallback policy if spot nodes reclaim during peak?

joyce-infra: policy: prefer spot for T4s; autoscaler with 2:1 on-demand buffer (min-on-demand 2 nodes), and a fallback route in routing policy to eu-west3 if ap-south2 capacity < 20% for 10m (via smart-routing).

oncall: deploy-bot: cluster create job completed: kubeadm init succeeded, control plane at 10.100.0.5.

joyce-infra: preflight command list (paste for quick copy):
```
# validate control plane reachable
curl -k https://10.100.0.5:6443/healthz
kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf get nodes -o wide
# check calico pods
kubectl -n kube-system get pods -l k8s-app=calico-node
# GPU plugin
kubectl -n kube-system get ds -l name=nvidia-device-plugin-daemonset
```

mike-sre: validation steps after addons: 1) `kubectl get cs` 2) run `kubectl run pgpu --image=nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:23.08 -it --rm --limits nvidia.com/gpu=1 -- sleep 60` to ensure scheduling, 3) `kubectl describe pod` for device plugin events.

joyce-infra: installing base addons: coredns (default), calico (custom MTU), metrics-server with `--kubelet-insecure-tls` for now, nginx-ingress-controller with service type=LoadBalancer and annotations for provider internal LB.

sam-neteng: add e2e network check: `iperf3` between A100 and T4 nodes (pod-to-pod) to verify 9k flows; capture pcap if MTU red flags.

alex-mlinfra: cost note: A100 pool reserved for latency-critical runs; T4 spot pool for async batch. Tag nodes with `team=ml, workload=infra` and set resourceQuota on namespaces to avoid runaway gpu requests.

joyce-infra: handoff checklist for oncall:
- control plane kubeconfig saved to vault path `secret/clusters/ap-south2/kubeconfig`
- kube-apiserver audit enabled (sample rate 0.1)
- RBAC: cluster-admin limited to infra-admins team
- create alert on node GPU pressure > 90% for 2m
- autoscaler configured with scaleDownDisabled=false, maxSurge=1, buffer policy for on-demand

oncall: noted, will take ownership after smoke window. please post `kubectl get nodes` output in this thread once all nodes are Ready. :thumbsup:

joyce-infra: smoke results: all 12 nodes Ready (4 control, 4 A100, 4 T4-spot), calico pods running, metrics-server fetching kubelet metrics, device plugin DaemonSet ready on all GPU nodes. posting `kubectl get nodes -o wide` below clipped output.

mike-sre: small followups: add PodDisruptionBudgets for A100s core services, create backup of etcd snapshot, and schedule a canary deployment to validate routing fallback.

joyce-infra: will file followup tickets and tag `oncall` for the handoff. thanks everyone. :rocket:
